Joshua_1: 1 of the 12 spies (called Hoshea)- from Ephraim (Numbers 13:8), servant of Moses (Exodus 17:9)
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Asa_1: King of Judah (1 Kings 15:9), son of incestuous relationship between Abijah and his mother, Maacah (1 Kings 15:10)
Jehu_1: son of Hanani (1 Kings 16:1) and a prophet (1 Kings 16:12) [seer in 2 Chronicles 16:7]
Elah_2: son of Baasha and King of Israel (1 Kings 16:6)
Omri_1: commander of the army and king over Israel (1 Kings 16:16)
Tibni_1: half of Israel wanted him to be king (1 Kings 16:21)
Shemer_1: sold the hill of Samaria (Shomron) to King Omri (1 Kings 16:24)
Ahab_1: son of Omri and King of Israel (1 Kings 16:28)
Ethbaal_1: father of Jezebel and king of the Sidonians (1 Kings 16:31)
Hiel_1: the Bethelite who rebuilt Jericho (1 Kings 16:34)
Abiram_2: firstborn son of Hiel who died when his father rebuilt Jericho (1 Kings 16:34)
Segub_1: youngest son of Hiel who died when his father rebuilt Jericho (1 Kings 16:34)
